title: COP31 Draft Drops Fossil Fuel Language, Keeps Power Target
description: The latest COP31 decision text draft drops fossil fuel language and an adaptation finance figure while retaining electrification and carbon capture proposals.

title: COP31: Civil Society groups fault omitting fossil fuel phase-out from draft text
description: In the new draft text, PREMIUM TIMES observed that all references to transitioning away from fossil fuels or roadmaps for the transition have been removed. The post COP31: Civil Society groups fault omitting fossil fuel phase-out from draft text appeared first on Premium Times Nigeria.

title: COP31: Cover decision draft drops fossil fuel phaseout language, retains '35 by 35' electrification target
description: The revised cover decision proposes raising electricity's share of global final energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035, but leaves adaptation finance without a clear monetary target, exposing divisions between developed and developing countries

title: Fossil fuels score 2 wins 5,000 miles apart
description: Negotiators at the climate talks walked back language against oil and gas while the U.S., China and Russia vowed to ramp up production.

title: COP31 Draft Deal Drops Fossil Fuel Language, Dims Ambition
description: Conference coverage By Laura Quinones in AntalyaA cat named Ambition went missing again at COP31 on Thursday. While activists delivered the message
